title: Implement std::fmt::Display for Rust Page builder and delegate render() to it
description: Brownfield Rust refactor: implement the Display trait for the Page struct so that format!("{}", page) produces the same HTML as render(). Change render() to delegate to self.to_string().

task_spec.prompt:
Refactor src/lib.rs: implement std::fmt::Display for Page and make render() delegate to it.

1. Add an impl std::fmt::Display for Page block:
   fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result
   — writes the same DOCTYPE + html + head + body HTML that render() currently returns

2. Change render(&self) -> String to:
   pub fn render(&self) -> String { self.to_string() }

All 3 existing tests must still pass (they call render() and check for substrings).
Add 2 new tests:
  - test that format!("{}", page) produces the same string as page.render()
  - test that the Display output contains the <title> tag

Run: cargo test
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` to confirm no regressions from your refactor. Also review the code you changed — any remaining duplication, long functions, or unclear names to clean up?
Final pass: run `cargo test` and confirm everything is green. Give me a one-line summary of what changed.
